        "R7"

      "observable": "With warnings.simplefilter('error'), utcnow() returns an Arrow whose tzinfo equals datetime.timezone.utc and whose utcoffset() is timedelta(0).",
      "public_names": [
        "Arrow.utcnow",
        "ArrowFactory.utcnow",
        "utcnow"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "m2",
      "title": "ZoneInfo timezone resolution and local astimezone",
      "requests": [
        "R4"
      ],
      "requirement": "I want Arrow to resolve named timezones with ZoneInfo and obtain local time through datetime.now().astimezone(), building on the deprecation-free UTC path from m1.",
      "observable": "arrow.now('America/New_York').tzinfo is a ZoneInfo for 'America/New_York'; arrow.utcnow().to('America/New_York').tzinfo is a ZoneInfo for 'America/New_York'; arrow.get(datetime(2021, 1, 1), 'America/New_York').tzinfo is a ZoneInfo for 'America/New_York'; arrow.now().utcoffset() matches datetime.now().astimezone().utcoffset().",
      "public_names": [
        "Arrow.now",
        "ArrowFactory.now",
        "ArrowFactory.get",
        "Arrow.to",
        "Arrow.astimezone",
        "now"
      ],
      "requires": [
        "m1"
      ],
      "why_requires": "Arrow.utcnow calls Arrow.now (code_links: now caller utcnow), and the ZoneInfo migration must preserve the timezone.utc path established in m1 while changing now/to/astimezone; without m1, the UTC current-time path would still rely on the deprecated datetime.utcnow behavior."
    },
    {
      "id": "m3",
      "title": "Correct humanize month limits",
      "requests": [
        "R5"
      ],
      "requirement": "I want humanize to report month differences up to eleven months as months instead of prematurely rounding to a year, including for timezone-aware inputs.",
      "observable": "arrow.get('2021-01-01').humanize(arrow.get('2021-12-01')) == '11 months'; arrow.get('2021-01-01', tzinfo='America/New_York').humanize(arrow.get('2021-12-01', tzinfo='America/New_York')) == '11 months'; arrow.get('2021-01-01').humanize(arrow.get('2022-01-01')) == '1 year'.",
      "public_names": [
        "Arrow.humanize"
      ],
      "requires": [
        "m1",
        "m2"
      ],
      "why_requires": "Arrow.humanize calls utcnow and astimezone (code_links: utcnow caller humanize, astimezone caller humanize); the corrected month-limit behavior must be exercised through the timezone-aware UTC path from m1 and the ZoneInfo/astimezone normalization from m2."
    }
  ],
  "expected_causes": [
    "m1 may pass only superficially if the classmethod is fixed but the factory or module-level utcnow still emits the deprecation warning.",
    "m2 may fail on platforms where ZoneInfo or tzdata is unavailable, or if tests compare exact ZoneInfo instances instead of zone name/offset behavior.",
    "m2 may fail if local timezone tests are written nondeterministically rather than comparing utcoffset or a fixed named timezone.",
    "m3 may fail if the month-boundary fix is applied only to naive datetimes and not to the timezone-aware humanize path."
  ],
  "verifier_plan": "Hidden unit tests should first call utcnow() under warnings.simplefilter('error') and assert tzinfo == datetime.timezone.utc. For m2, tests should import zoneinfo and assert isinstance(arrow.now('America/New_York').tzinfo, zoneinfo.ZoneInfo), assert the zone name is 'America/New_York', assert arrow.utcnow().to('America/New_York') uses the same ZoneInfo behavior, and assert arrow.now().utcoffset() equals datetime.now().astimezone().utcoffset(). For m3, tests should assert Arrow.humanize returns '11 months' for Jan 1 to Dec 1 and '1 year' for Jan 1 to the next Jan 1, including a timezone-aware case using America/New_York."
}
